title: 25 Years Anniversary
text: The 25th Anniversary Fundraising Dinner was nothing short of extraordinary. A perfect blend of elegance, laughter, purpose, and powerful connections. To everyone who showed up, dressed up, pledged, gave, danced, cheered, and stood with us; thank you. You’ve written yourselves into the legacy of Green Acres. Here’s to 25 years of impact, and to the future we’re building together.

title: Our students had an eye-opening experience visiting CRDB Bank HQ
text: An unforgettable day of unity, purpose, and partnership! Green Acres Schools had the honour of hosting students, parents, and teachers and our incredible 25th Anniversary partner, CRDB Bank, led by the inspiring Director of Human Resources, Mr. Godfrey Rutasingwa. Together, we celebrated more than just a visit. We celebrated a shared mission to nurture smart minds and financially empowered futures through the #JuniorJumbo youth banking product. The energy, the ideas, the commitment, all fueled by a common dream: to raise champions in and out of the classroom! Thank you, CRDB, for believing in the power of education and youth potential.

title: Sunday vibes filled with faith and gratitude! Our students joined the beautiful service at KKKT
text: Sunday vibes filled with faith and gratitude! Our students joined the beautiful service at KKKT Mbezi Beach Lutheran Church to thank God for 25 amazing years of blessings, growth, and impact. Big thanks to our sponsor, CRDB Bank, for walking this journey with us. The celebration continues!

title: Maulid Day – A Celebration of Faith & Unity
text: Maulid Day at Green Acres Schools was a beautiful occasion of reflection, gratitude, and togetherness. Students, staff, and the community gathered to honor the birth of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) through recitations, prayers, and cultural performances. The event highlighted our commitment to nurturing spiritual values alongside academic excellence, fostering respect, compassion, and harmony among all.

title: 25 Years of Caring: Sharing Love at Mwananyamala Hospital
text: Spreading love and compassion at Mwananyamala Hospital — a special moment as we mark 25 years of Green Acres School. Thank you to CRDB Bank for walking this journey with us.

title: Bujugo Day
text: “An unforgettable day of fierce competition, camaraderie, and school pride at our sports bonanza! Huge thanks to all the amazing participants who gave it their all and made this event a success. Grateful to have had other schools join us in this exhilarating experience. Already counting down the days until the next event!

title: Bukoba Airport School Trip
text: Our pupils had the opportunity to visit Bukoba Airport, Kaitaba Stadium, and the Eco Beach shores. While at the airport, we learned a lot. The children had the chance to board a real airplane, learn about various job duties, and explore different airport activities. We truly enjoyed this trip, and we cannot wait for the next one.

title: School Tour to Kagera Sugar Industry
text: Our students had an exciting and educational visit to the Kagera Sugar Industry, where they explored the fascinating process of sugar production from cane to crystal. The tour provided hands-on learning experiences in agriculture, factory operations, and environmental sustainability. Beyond academics, it inspired curiosity, teamwork, and appreciation for local industries that contribute to Tanzania’s growth.

title: School Tour to Kaole Historical Site – Bagamoyo
text: Our learners embarked on a captivating journey to the Kaole Historical Site in Bagamoyo, a place rich in history and culture. They explored ancient ruins, mosques, and tombs dating back to the 13th century, gaining insight into Tanzania’s early trade, culture, and the Swahili civilization. The tour sparked curiosity about our heritage, deepened respect for our history, and provided an unforgettable learning experience outside the classroom.

title: Form VI Graduation Day – Celebrating Success & New Beginnings
text: A day filled with pride, joy, and inspiration as our Form VI students marked the completion of their secondary school journey. From the grand procession and heartfelt speeches to the awarding of certificates and moments of laughter with friends, the celebration reflected years of hard work, resilience, and personal growth. These pictures capture the smiles, the tears of joy, and the promise of bright futures ahead.

title: Skonga TV Visits Green Acres Schools
text: We were delighted to welcome Skonga TV to Green Acres Schools for an exclusive feature. The programme showcased our dynamic learning environment, modern facilities, and the achievements of our students and staff. From classroom activities to co-curricular highlights, the visit captured the essence of our mission — nurturing confident, skilled, and values-driven learners ready to make a positive impact in Tanzania and beyond.
